exposure: Mode of delivery (operative delivery vs. spontaneous vaginal delivery)
Fetal occiput position at delivery (occiput anterior vs. occiput posterior)
cohort: 368 nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies at ≥ 37 weeks' gestation
finding: A narrow subpubic arch angle (SPA) is associated with a higher risk of persistent occiput posterior position at delivery and operative delivery.
mod_finding: A narrower SPA was significantly associated with operative delivery compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery.
